in_marathi.name: Anandini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anandini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anandini is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ananda’ meaning ‘joy, happiness, or bliss’. The feminine suffix ‘ini’ denotes a woman or a goddess. In Hindu mythology, Anandini is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing joy, prosperity, and abundance.
